_provenance: Independently established heavy-atom counts for every token the arity sweep could corroborate. Candidates: every morpheme in the oracle's own lexicon, every alphabetic run and every locant-stripped word segment of every name in  + packs/*.json, and every whole gold PIN. TRUTH IS NOT FROM THE ORACLE'S TABLES: it is the heavy-atom count of the structure OPSIN 2.9.0 builds for the text, by up to three routes -- the standalone radical (--allowRadicals), the token hosted on benzene minus benzene's own 6, and the token parsed as a whole name. A count is recorded only when every route that succeeded agreed AND either the radical route succeeded or at least two routes agreed, because the benzene host can under-count a fusion prefix whose atoms are shared with the host ring. OPSIN is used here purely as a STRUCTURE oracle (how many atoms does this text denote), never as an authority on which name is preferred.
